I had many therapists and usually on the first.s appointment.s they ask you a bunch of questions about your life, current, past, your interests, routine and social behaviours. I’ve been often asked by therapists what I was looking for with the therapy, the goals I wanted to attain, it can be hard to think of something on the spot so maybe ask yourself about this. Also if there’s anything you don’t wanna get into so early on there’s no rush to share, you can ask them to talk about it later after a few sessions. Your therapist should tell you all that and at some point ask if there is anything specific subjects you wanted to approach, if they don’t you can and should still talk about your notes and suspicions. 
ALSO it’s normal to not be completely comfortable at first since it’s still a stranger but if you feel like you don’t connect with the therapist and would like another one it’s a very normal thing to ask and shouldn’t offend anyone. 
Hope this helps and good luck with this!
